verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring filings or workflows is a fair question for a business-filing portal, but the evidence shows no such feature. Preclearance before an intended filing date (docs-20) is a one-off request, and bulk data files (docs-3) are a data product, not a user-schedulable job. No API or automation surface was found (probe-3), and the portal is behind bot management and User Access controls.
